why: Gregory Chambers (arXiv, posted online March 2025) proved that Jordan curves sufficiently close to a C² curve admit an inscribed square of positive side length, a partial case advance; separately, a November 2025 Medium post by Yoshiki Ueoka claims a full solution for C⁰ Jordan curves via human/Gemini AI collaboration, unverified and outside normal peer review.
